factual_fidelity.evidence: 'Dieses freistehende Einfamilienhaus' contradicts the input photo analysis 'semi-detached house' — freestanding vs semi-detached is a material misrepresentation.

completeness.evidence: Mentions 195 m², 4 Schlafzimmer, 2 Badezimmer, Garten, Terrasse, Stellplatz, Keller, Kamin, Frühstücksbereich — all key inputs covered.

native_quality.evidence: Reads natively: 'doppelflügelige Türen einen direkten Zugang zur Terrasse und dem südlich ausgerichteten Garten ermöglichen' — fluent though slightly bureaucratic.

market_fit.evidence: Uses LU/DE real-estate idiom: 'gepflegter Zustand', 'Wohnkomfort', 'Stellplatz', 'Frühstücksbereich' align with athome.lu DE listings.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE class invented; prose omits energy class entirely, consistent with v1.5 default given no class in inputs.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Gepflegtes Einfamilienhaus mit Garten und Terrasse in ruhiger Wohnlage' = 9 words but says Einfamilienhaus (freestanding) which contradicts the property; no neighborhood. Hashtags are in English ('FourBedrooms', 'SouthFacingGarden') — mismatched language.

tone_discipline.evidence: No hyperbole or exclamation; 'behagliche Wärme', 'entspannten Nutzung' are restrained.

fair_housing.evidence: No demographic references; 'zeitgemäße Wohnstruktur' is neutral.

hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 2 — 'freistehende Einfamilienhaus' (input says semi-detached), 'private Zufahrtstor' (a gate is not in inputs; inputs say 'private driveway'). 'mehrere Fenster' is also somewhat invented but generic.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: Numeric agreement (195 m², 4 bed, 2 bath) holds across FR/EN/DE. However listing-kind/property-type disagreement: FR 'maison mitoyenne' and EN 'semi-detached house' agree with input, but DE 'freistehende Einfamilienhaus' asserts freestanding — a feature-list/type disagreement on the same property.
